page_title: Duckie: Build AI Support Agents in Minutes | Y Combinator

summary.name: Duckie
summary.one_liner: Duckie is an AI technical support assistant that lets support and engineering teams build AI agents that answer issues from their existing knowledge sources.
use_cases: resolving support channel issues in Slack
processing customer refunds with AI workflows
helping new engineers set up local environments
summary.what_it_does: Duckie connects to a team's knowledge sources such as Slack, Jira, Confluence and Sentry to find relevant information and suggest issue resolutions. When a new issue appears in a support channel, it replies in the thread with where to look and how to fix it, citing reference sources. It answers follow-up questions instantly and writes learnings from issue resolution back into the team's documentation. The page also says it can handle post-mortems and status updates, and that support teams can turn their tasks into AI workflows.
notable: Connects to Slack, Jira, Confluence and Sentry and writes updates back to documentation
Replies in support threads with reference sources
Founded 2023, Y Combinator Winter 2024 batch, team of 4 in San Francisco
Demo-based onboarding: book a demo to get it live in your channel
caveats: Pricing is not listed on the page; access is via booking a demo
Platform support beyond the named integrations is not stated
